before.name: desktop
comparisonHeadings: The Vercel, Supabase and Resend alternative.
before.comparisonBeforeCards:
The Vercel, Supabase and Resend alternative.

Vercel hosts, Supabase stores, Resend sends — three accounts, three base fees, and every extra project adds a Supabase compute charge. Here the same stack runs from one balance, and an extra project costs only the credits it uses.

An alternative. Know the differences.

Compare ohmyho.st with Vercel for app hosting, Supabase for managed Postgres, and Resend for transactional email. Explore the differences in features, pricing and limits.

ohmyho.st is an independent service, not affiliated with or endorsed by Vercel, Supabase or Resend. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.
priceNotes: Credits reset on your billing day. Idle database compute can suspend. Retained storage and deployed resources still use credits — top up any time.
$10/month includes 1,000 credits across your projects. Usage is metered; additional credits cost extra. Applicable taxes are added.
Monthly plan credits expire at the end of each billing period. Connect your own domain; domain registration is not included.
before.cta: 200 credits, free. No card, no dashboard.
